description: Whimsical Flying Dragon with iridescent scales, expressive eyes, playful mouth features, and a tail with distinct feathers.

components: Two large, sharp claws on each wing
Tail with four distinct, colorful feathers at the end
Head with big, expressive eyes and a wide smile
Smiling mouth with one long, curved, toothy fang
Small, playful feet with opposable digits
drawing_instructions.composition: The dragon is positioned in the center of the composition. Its head and smile are facing towards the viewer, indicating a friendly interaction. The large claws on each wing point downwards towards the ground, creating an illusion of thrust. The tail ends gracefully upwards, resembling a playful gesture. The iridescent scales cover most of its body, giving it a shimmering appearance. The eyes emit soft, magical light that draws attention to them. The two long, curved fangs are visible in the smile, emphasizing the dragon's whimsical and playful nature.
drawing_instructions.intent: Create a whimsical flying dragon line drawing without repeating previous elements.
drawing_instructions.revision_reason: Previous feedback did not incorporate elements such as iridescent scales, distinct feathers at the tail end, and playful mouth features like the toothy fang.

The composition is spatially ambiguous despite filling much of the canvas. This is image observation, not a human evaluation.
